description: Search the curated studies by keywords (title, finding, authors, journal, model system), optionally filtered by evidence code, a linked entity (gene, drug, disease...) and year range. Returns summary records with evidence codes and URLs.

entity.description: Only studies linked to this entity (name, synonym or id), e.g. "Rheb".

evidence_code.description: Keep only these evidence codes, e.g. ["H","S"] for human evidence.

offset.description: For the next page: pass next_offset from the previous answer.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. "rapamycin lifespan mice". Omit to list by filters only.

name: search_studies
title: Search studies
